ruleDefinitions.name: Service Binary in Suspicious Folder
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect the creation of a service with a service binary located in a suspicious directory Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: ((registry_path = RGX("^HKLM\\\\System\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Services\\\\") AND registry_path = RGX("\\\\Start$") AND (process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Perflogs\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\ADMIN\\$\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Temp\\\\.*")) AND (Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000000\)" OR Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000001\)" OR Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000002\)")) OR (registry_path = RGX("^HKLM\\\\System\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Services\\\\") AND registry_path = RGX("\\\\ImagePath$") AND (Details = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\\\Perflogs\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\\\ADMIN\\$\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\\\Temp\\\\.*")))) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Common\\ Files\\\\.*") AND process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Temp\\\\.*")))
